classification: development, known cases, no held-out set
primary_metric: task correctly concluded within the declared documentary slice
comparators: direct JSON pointer lookup and persisted receipt parsing

missions.reconstruct: Exact status/trial and explicit selected-slice limits for reason/sample; no causal or scientific inference
missions.resume: Completed workflow is readable in a later process, steps not repeated, cancelled workflow stays cancelled
missions.compare: Both result artifacts match independently read source field values; count units are fields
missions.reuse: Same procedure succeeds on another identity, refuses a missing pointer, and keeps confirmed receipts byte-stable

claim_limit: No product superiority or scientific contribution may be inferred from this pilot. Repeated missions use the same two sources, not independent episodes.
